forum.title: Marking of STH145N8F7-2AG
forum.best_answer_content:
The marking 145N8F7 was the one set at the market launch of the [STH145N8F7-2AG](https://www.st.com/en/power-transistors/sth145n8f7-2ag.html) and recorded in the [data sheet](https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/sth145n8f7-2ag.pdf). Shortly afterwards, only the marking with the additional suffix -2 was used, but unfortunately, the data sheet was not corrected, for which I would like to apologise. The marking **145N8F7-2** is therefore correct and you have purchased the right device.

Regards

/Peter
forum.content_text:
Hi Engineer，

Based on the data sheet, the marking of STH145N8F7-2AG should be "145N8F7 ", but the parts I purchased were with marking of "145N8F7-2".

Could you help suggest whether I purchased correct parts?

![1.jpg](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/0218a18a-35e2-1eb4-c85c-c72560da7167.jpg "1.jpg")

Thanks,

Haddy
